cohort: 288 women with singleton pregnancies between 27 and 34 weeks of gestation
finding: The study found that neonates born to women who underwent cesarean delivery were at a greater risk of presenting with respiratory distress than those who had spontaneous vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Neonates of women who had cesarean deliveries were at a greater risk of presenting with respiratory distress than those who had spontaneous vaginal deliveries.
